name: Battery
description: Charge level: red under 25 %, amber under 50 %.
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 140 70" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<style>
.lvl{fill:#34c759;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:left center;transform:scaleX(var(--v))}
[data-level="0"] .lvl,[data-level="1"] .lvl,[data-level="2"] .lvl{fill:#ea4335}
[data-level="3"] .lvl,[data-level="4"] .lvl{fill:#f9ab00}
.pct{font:700 20px system-ui,sans-serif;text-anchor:middle;dominant-baseline:central;fill:#fff;paint-order:stroke;stroke:rgba(0,0,0,.35);stroke-width:3px}
</style>
<rect x="3" y="6" width="118" height="58" rx="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="5"/>
<rect x="124" y="23" width="12" height="24" rx="4" fill="currentColor"/>
<rect class="lvl" x="11" y="14" width="102" height="42" rx="6"/>
<text class="pct" x="62" y="35">{{pct}}%</text>
</svg>
